pattern_1.transformation: Parse local timestamp from 'Time' using format '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M'. Convert from America/Denver (Mountain Time) to UTC and format as ISO 8601.
Assign site_id from the source filename: each CSV is one PumpHouse station (ER-PHS1, ER-PHS2, ER-PHS3, ER-PHS4).

Map the soil sensor channel to its installation depth (from the package field notes / measurementTechnique): S1=115 cm (106 cm at ER-PHS4), S2=60 cm, S3=30 cm, S4=10 cm; the S5 water-potential sensor is at 30 cm.
pattern_1.unit_conversion: Depths taken from field notes in cm and converted to m (divide by 100).

pattern_1.transformation: Melt the four Teros12 soil VWC channels (S1-S4) from wide to long; each value becomes one observation at the channel's depth. Source instrument: Teros12.
pattern_1.unit_conversion: None; source units are already m3 m-3.

pattern_1.transformation: Map the S5 MPS6 (TEROS 21) matric-potential channel at 30 cm. Replace the -99999 missing-value sentinel with NaN. The ER-PHS4 S5 channel is entirely sentinel-valued (no valid water potential).
pattern_1.unit_conversion: None; source units are already kPa (negative).
